description: Defines a class 'logical_channel_config_list' managing a list of logical channel configurations with lookup and validation mechanisms, used in scheduling within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: logical_channel_config_list
classes.description: Manages a list of logical channel configurations with lookup and validation features.

methods.name: logical_channel_config_list
methods.description: Default constructor and constructor initializing with a list of logical channel configs, performing sorting and validation.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Returns a span of logical channel configurations.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LCID or LCG-ID is present in the list.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Retrieves the logical channel configuration for a given LCID.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of logical channels.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two logical channel config lists for equality.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two logical channel config lists.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of list.
